spans.s: अवेक्षण n. 1. Looking towards; 2. attention, care, वर्णाश्रमावेक्षणजागरूकः R.xiv.85; 3. regarding, considering, R.xiv.67.
अवेक्षा f. The same as अवेक्षण q.v.
अवेद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) 1. Unknowable; 2. unobtainable, unattainable.
अवेद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) 1. Unknowable; 2. unobtainable, unattainable.
अवेल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Untimely; 2. without any limit.
अवेल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Untimely; 2. without any limit.
आवेग m. 1. Hurry; 2. flurry, agitation, Am.
; 3. agitation considered as one of the 33 subordinate feelings (in rhetoric).
आवेदन n. 1. Representation; 2. stating a complaint (in law); 3. a plaint (in law).

आवेश m. 1. Entering, entrance; 2. entertaining, giving place to, तस्मै स्मयावेशविवर्जिताय R.v.19; 3. intent Bes, devotedness to an object; 4. pride, arrogance; 5. flurry, agitation; 6. demoniacal possession.
आवेशन n. 1. Entrance; 2. demoniacal possession; 3. passion, fury; 4. a work-shop, a manufactory; 5. a house, a dwelling.
आवेशिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Own, peculiar; 2. inherent.
आवेशिक (II) m. A guest, a visitor.

आवेष्टक m. A wall, a fence, an enclosure.
आवेष्टन m. 1. Wrapping round, tying; 2. a wrapper, an envelop; 3. a wall, a fence.
